messages.text:
I can't refund both items, so the all-or-nothing refund you asked for isn't possible.

- **Pen organizer (order h196-o2):** The policy refuses this one. A refund must be requested within 30 days of delivery. This order was delivered on 2026-09-30, so the deadline was 2026-10-30 10:00 UTC. It has passed (refund-policy/v2/window).
- **Desk calendar stand (order h196-o1):** This one is eligible. The shop's records show it was received back (refund-policy/v2/return). The refund would be 88.90 BRL, which is what you paid for it (refund-policy/v2/amount).

Since you only want the two refunded together, I haven't proposed anything. If you'd like the calendar stand refunded on its own, tell me and I'll prepare that proposal.
